name: ColorSwatchPicker
description: A colour from the ones the app sends, as swatches: a theme's or a label's colour. The free colour picker is left out until an app needs one.

label.description: Names it for a screen reader; it is not drawn.

defaultValue.description: Starts on this colour; the merchant changes it.

value.description: Pinned: shows exactly this colour until the next tree.

layout.description: grid wraps the swatches into rows; stack sets them in a column.
